description: How the six-card two-path decision tarot spread compares two options side by side, with each position explained and tips for reading the pairs.
lede: The two-path decision tarot spread compares two options by asking what each offers and what each asks of you. It does not choose for you.

layout.alt: Six numbered tarot cards for a two-path decision. Card 1, The situation, is at the top centre. Path A is the left column: 2 Path A offers and 3 Path A asks. Path B is the right column: 4 Path B offers and 5 Path B asks. Card 6, Advice, is at the bottom centre.
layout.caption: Each path gets an offer and an ask, so the two options can be compared side by side before the advice card at the bottom.
